name: Q₈
notes: DRAFT — arrows incomplete. Fill in where every node goes under ·i and under ·j, then run: npm run check groups/drafts/q8.group.json. The facts you need: i²=j²=k²=-1; i·j=k, j·k=i, k·i=j; j·i=-k, k·j=-i, i·k=-j; -1 commutes with everything and (-1)²=1. Note that ⟨i⟩ reaches only four of the eight, which is why two generators are needed. Carter writes this group Q₄; most other sources write Q₈. Same group.
source: hand-authored — Carter, Visual Group Theory, exercise 4.6(b)
